verdict.rationale: Angular's official repository points developers to a first-party upgrade guide for finding the best way to upgrade a project (angular-gh-3). The official CLI also documents a command that updates the workspace and its dependencies (angular-docs-15), which gives the guide a concrete upgrade path. missing for 10: any detail on the guide's contents (version-to-version steps, breaking-change or migration instructions), and independent or hands-on reports of upgrading with it.
